sources.author: Special Service and Features
sources.title: Hydroponic Ganja seizure at Chennai International Airport
sources.excerpt: Based on Passenger profiling, officers of the Air Intelligence Unit (AIU), Chennai Customs intercepted an Indian male passenger, who had arrived at Chennai International Airport from Dubai on 13 September 2026. The passenger attempted to exit through the Green Channel without making any declaration to Customs. Upon detailed examination of his checked-in baggage, 04 transparent airtight packets containing dried greenish-brown flowering and fruiting tops of a plant, suspected to be hydroponically cultivated Cannabis (Ganja), were recovered. The packets had been ingeniously concealed inside the Baby Diaper Bag, Detergent Powder Packet and Chessboard box kept in the checked-in baggage.

sources.author: PIB Backgrounder
sources.title: Incentive Scheme for Promotion of Domestic PNG Connections
sources.excerpt: Piped Natural Gas (PNG) expansion is an important part of India’s transition towards cleaner household energy and energy security. Supplying PNG to homes is part of City Gas Distribution (CGD) network development. Such a network comprises pipelines and allied facilities that serve households, commercial establishments, and industrial units. Entities authorised by the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) develop it. PNGRB has authorised entities in 309 Geographical Areas (GAs) . Together, these areas span the entire mainland of the country. As of 18 August 2026, there were 1.74 crore domestic PNG connections across the country.

sources.excerpt: The three-day Dryland Congress 2026 concluded today in New Delhi with a strong call for greater South–South and triangular cooperation to accelerate solutions for dryland agriculture.
